method: Independent read-only source review against the frozen private-links design; no reviewer execution of Motion tests, builds, browsers, servers or runtime gates.
scope: Publisher committed capture; raw drafts, gestures, tween ownership and changed-back intent invalidation; late cancellation and private setup key retirement.
Viewer fragment scrubbing, exact receipt hash/byte checks, late decoded-image cleanup, captured PNG/GIF artifacts and explicit fresh local-copy ProjectLibrary receipt/CAS.
Canonical configured authority, bounded nofollow configuration files, raw socket slots before TLS, trickle/phase/aggregate deadlines, one HTTP request and private-safe errors.

Bind-before-store admission, authenticated opened-file receipts, owned filesystem identity checks, index visibility commit, durable revocation, protected postcommit failures and shutdown ownership before lifetime-lock release.

findings.finding: Browser error handling used foreign error-code names rather than MotionError wire codes, obscuring capacity and unavailable-link guidance.
findings.repair: Browser-local fixed private-safe messages now cover all ten actual MotionError codes; the reviewer reread the repaired source.

limitations: Read-only review is not a replacement for native or protocol verification.
No physical-device, worst-case RAM, CI or deployment verification claimed.
Same-UID hostile mutation is not sandboxed; review applies to the documented pinned-identity checks and detected-replacement refusal.
